intro.data: One machine is not enough. Feed the output of the first into a second to reach the goal.
intro.alchemy: One apparatus is not enough. Feed the output of the first into a second to reach the goal.
intro.spellcraft: One rune is not enough. Feed the output of the first into a second to reach the goal.
intro.abstract: One process is not enough. Feed the output of the first into a second to reach the goal.

goal.data: Build A to B to C by chaining two machines, then reveal composition (g after f).
goal.alchemy: Build A to B to C by chaining two apparatuses, then reveal composition (g after f).
goal.spellcraft: Build A to B to C by chaining two runes, then reveal composition (g after f).
goal.abstract: Build A to B to C by chaining two processes, then reveal composition: g ∘ f.
